Maya (Docs): Quick sync — I'm doing a sweep to align terminology and voice across the reference docs + SDK snippets. Found lots of small divergences: 'model alias' vs 'model name', param casing (max_tokens vs maxTokens), and inconsistent use of 'response' vs 'completion'.
Liam (Eng): This is great. We saw runtime examples using camelCase in JS and snake_case in Python samples — confusing.
Adele (Product): +1. We should pick canonical terms and add a tiny section in the style guide so PMs can reference it.
Maya (Docs): Proposal: canonical terms -> 'model_name', 'response' (not completion), param casing: match SDK default (snake_case in Python, camelCase in JS). Add a glossary entry for each mapping and a migration section. Thoughts?
Samer (SDK): Sounds good. For SDK snippets I can do a compatibility comment block so users know old params still work. Example I was thinking to add: 
```
# before
client.generate(model='redwood-v1', max_tokens=256)
# after (explicit canonical)
client.generate(model_name='redwood-v1', max_tokens=256)
# JS example
// before
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-v1', maxTokens: 256 })
// after
client.generate({ modelName: 'redwood-v1', maxTokens: 256 })
```
Maya (Docs): Nice — add a short note about automatic fallback (old keys still accepted) so we avoid churn.
Liam (Eng): Also found two reference pages where links to the SDK snippets are 404s (they've been moved). docs-bot flagged them in PR 318.
docs-bot: Link-check failed for PR #318 — 2 missing snippet files: `snippets/js/generate-example.js`, `snippets/py/stream-example.py`.
Maya (Docs): I'll patch the reference pages to point to the new snippet locations and add redirects. Will also add the glossary mappings as a single page (docs/style/terminology-mapping.md) + short migration guide.
Samer (SDK): I'll open two PRs: SDK-snippet-casing-fix-js (#322) and SDK-snippet-casing-fix-py (#323). ETA by EOD tomorrow.
Adele (Product): Can you add a microcopy blurb for the console UI explaining 'model_name' vs the shiny UI label? We should avoid users thinking they need to change runtime configuration.
Maya (Docs): Yep — I'll add that to the migration guide. Action items:
- Maya: create glossary page + migration guide + update broken links (PR 324)
- Samer: two SDK snippet PRs (#322, #323) to normalize casing and add compatibility comments
- Liam: review the runtime examples and flag any API mismatches (will do by EOD)
- Adele: add console microcopy suggestion (will submit a small copy PR)
Maya (Docs): tagging for visibility @Samer (SDK) @Liam (Eng) @Adele (Product) — will loop back once PRs are up. :thumbsup:
